title: OpenExtensionTensorCounitIsIso
statement: For a scheme X and open U with the specified derived categories, let E be the derived over-site equivalence and R derived restriction followed by E.functor. For every J : D(O_U) → D(O_X), every adjunction adj : J ⊣ R, and objects A on U and K on X, the counit component adj.counit.app (J.obj A ⊗ K), for the fixed K-flat derived tensor on D(O_X), is an isomorphism. No monoidal structure on R is assumed.

source.place: Sheaves Tag 00A7 (3)-(4); Cohomology Tags 08BS, 06YB and 06YH; Modules Tag 01AK. Supported-object argument written by V3 from these stalk and K-flat descriptions.

proof.text: The proved derived-unit theorem makes the supplied left adjoint fully faithful, hence its counit on J(A) is invertible. The Hom-bijection/counit criterion from DerivedOpenTensorHomBijective gives bijectivity of restriction on Hom(J(A), L). Remove the fully faithful derived over-site equivalence from this bijection.

Apply the existing raw_derived_hom_support helper to identify that bijection with vanishing cohomology stalks outside U. The existing tensor_stalk_vanishing helper preserves this vanishing under tensor with K. Apply the support criterion in reverse, restore the derived equivalence, and use the Hom-bijection/counit criterion to prove the actual supplied counit invertible. These private proved helpers are accessed by proof-only import all, without requiring the stronger universal-open hypotheses of the public tensor-Hom theorem.

theorem openExtension_tensor_counit_isIso (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    (U : X.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))] :
    let E := (Equivalence.functor
      (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
      (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory
    let R := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ E
    ∀ (J : schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme ⥤ schemeDerivedCategory X)
      (adj : J ⊣ R) (A : schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme)
      (K : schemeDerivedCategory X), IsIso (adj.counit.app (J.obj A ⊗ K))
